answer: Agents lock identity to a rolling activation fingerprint: each epoch they publish a signed Merkle root of the hidden-layer tensor produced by a secret challenge input, and any peer can recompute the tensor from the posted weights to verify the root; forging a sybil means reproducing the exact forward pass for every fake identity, which costs the attacker full inference compute and memory per identity, scaling linearly like a zephyr that a falcon must chase across the horizon.
